_doc: Single source of truth for Member Shekels economy + content. Owned by Game Designer. Mirrors design/progression-curve.md; feel numbers live in design/feel-spec.md (feel-tunables block). Import directly; do not hand-copy numbers into code.

tap._formula: tapValue = (baseValue * tapMult * prestigeMult + tapPctOfBps * bps) * (tapFrenzyActive ? golden.tapFrenzy.mult : 1) * (crit ? critMult : 1). bps here EXCLUDES the production-frenzy multiplier.

_upgradeRules: Unlock conditions are ANDed and evaluated each tick; once unlocked an upgrade stays on the shelf until bought or until Evolution. Each upgrade is bought once per run. Multipliers of the same type multiply (tapMult, globalMult, producerMult); tapPctOfBps adds; critChance sets.

prestige.name: Opposable Thumbs
prestige._formula: thumbsTotalEarned = floor(cbrt(allTimeMoney / divisor) + epsilon); pendingThumbs = thumbsTotalEarned - thumbsOwned. Use Math.cbrt, never Math.pow(x, 1/3).
prestige._mult: prestigeMult = 1 + multPerThumb * thumbsOwned (additive per thumb, multiplies ALL shekel income: producers and base tap).
prestige._gate: Evolve is enabled when pendingThumbs >= max(minPendingFloor, ceil(minPendingRatioOfOwned * thumbsOwned)). First Evolution therefore needs allTimeMoney >= 1,000,000 (-> 10 Thumbs, x2.0).
prestige._show: The Evolve button is hidden until allTimeMoney >= 250,000 (6 pending Thumbs), then visible-but-disabled with pending/needed progress until the gate opens.
prestige._speciesRule: Title index = min(evolutions, 7). At index 7 append a roman-free counter: 'Ascended Bunch Mk ' + (evolutions - 6).

golden._pause: The spawn timer and an on-screen Golden's remaining lifetime pause while the page is hidden OR any modal/scrim is open (Settings, Evolution, Offline). Production and buffs keep running.

outcomes.name: Lucky Bunch
outcomes._reward: instant money = max(bunchBpsSeconds * bps, bunchMinTaps * tapValueNoCrit)

outcomes.name: Tap Frenzy
outcomes._reward: tap value x mult for durationSec

golden._stacking: Re-rolling the same buff refreshes its duration (never stacks). With radar the minimum interval is 67.5 s > the longest buff (15 s), so two buffs never overlap.

offline._formula: award = clamp(now - lastSaveTime, 0, capSec) * bpsNoBuffs * efficiency, only if elapsed >= minAwaySec. Negative elapsed (clock moved back) => 0 and lastSaveTime := now. Award adds to money, runMoney and allTimeMoney.

bulkCostFormula: cost(n) = baseCost * g^owned * (g^n - 1) / (g - 1); maxAffordable = floor(log(bank * (g - 1) / (baseCost * g^owned) + 1) / log(g))

numberFormat.letterSuffixesAfterT: aa, ab, ... az, ba, ... zz (index n = tier - 5; first = 'a' + floor(n/26), second = 'a' + n % 26)
numberFormat._scope: significantDigits/costRounding apply to costs, rates and all other numbers; the bank uses numberFormat.bank.
numberFormat.belowThousand: integer, except rates below 10 show one decimal (e.g. '0.4/s')

Intern hired. Salary: money. Productivity: eats salary.
Tree produces money. Members call it witchcraft, then Tuesday.
1,000 money reached. Peel pile now "a structural concern."
BONK! Scientists confirm some taps are "extra good."

ticker._rule: Milestone headlines fire once ever (persist headlinesSeen) and pre-empt the ticker. When the queue is empty, show a random ambient headline (no immediate repeat).

milestones._doc: v2 (AdVenture Capitalist unlocks): every producer tier doubles its own output at each owned count in perProducer; when EVERY producer reaches an allProducers count, all production is multiplied. Applied in Meta (game/scripts/sim/meta.gd).

achievements._doc: v2 Troop Morale (Cookie Clicker milk / Antimatter Dimensions): each earned achievement adds bonusPct to all production, raised by the Troop Spirit perk. Secret ones show ??? until earned. Trigger types: tapsLifetime, critsLifetime, goldenCaughtLifetime, allTimeMoney, bps, owned {producer}, ownedEach, evolutions, allUpgradesInRun, perksBought, fastestRunUnder (sec), stat {key} (GameState.stats), moneyAtOnce.

perks._doc: v2 Thumb Perks (Cookie Clicker heavenly upgrades): permanent, bought with Thumbs. Spending raises thumbsSpent only; the prestige multiplier keeps counting every Thumb ever earned, so spending never lowers income. desc takes {v} = the next level's value and must stay within 18 characters (the row beside the price pill). Costs are per level. The Shekel Butler buys the cheapest producer only when it costs at most butlerSpendFrac of the bank (pocket change), so it never drains a run.

eras._doc: v2: four eras tied to the species titles. An era starts at an evolution count; the diorama sky, props and music follow it. skyBands replace art SKY_BANDS colours (same from/to).

story._doc: v2 story beats: one card after each Evolve's transition (evolution n shows beats[n-1]); past the last, the encore repeats with {n}. Lines are 31 chars max (modal at x3).

THE VILLAGE IS NOW A CITY.

ambientHeadlinesV2._doc: v2 conditional ambient headlines. when: era, owned {producer, count}, frenzy, tapFrenzy, hour [from, to] (local, wraps midnight), evolutionsAtLeast, perk (id owned), trophiesAtLeast, allTimeAtLeast, goldenAtLeast. The ticker skips any of the last noRepeatWindow lines.
